description: This file defines classes and structures related to Metal buffer management in the ANGLE graphics project, including BufferMtl, ConversionBufferMtl, and related classes for handling GPU buffers, conversions, and synchronization.

classes.name: ConversionBufferMtl
classes.description: Holds translated index and vertex data buffers with dirty state indicator.

classes.name: IndexConversionBufferMtl
classes.description: Specialized conversion buffer for index data with type and offset info.

classes.name: BufferHolderMtl
classes.description: Abstract class managing current GPU buffer reference with synchronization considerations.

classes.name: BufferMtl
classes.description: Main class implementing buffer operations for Metal, including data setting, mapping, and conversion buffers.

classes.name: VertexConversionBuffer
classes.description: Cache for converted vertex data identified by format, stride, and offset.

classes.name: SimpleWeakBufferHolderMtl
classes.description: Concrete class managing weak references to buffers for efficient reuse.

methods.name: getCurrentBuffer
methods.description: Returns the current GPU buffer, considering weak reference status.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets buffer data with specified target, data pointer, size, and usage.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a portion of the buffer with new data.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Copies data from a source buffer to this buffer.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the buffer for CPU access.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a specific range of the buffer for CPU access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the buffer after CPU access.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Retrieves the index range for drawing.

methods.name: getFirstLastIndices
methods.description: Gets the first and last indices in the buffer.

methods.name: getClientShadowCopyData
methods.description: Returns a shadow copy of the buffer data for client-side use.

methods.name: getVertexConversionBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a vertex conversion buffer for a specific format.

methods.name: getIndexConversionBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an index conversion buffer for a specific index type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the internal buffer reference in SimpleWeakBufferHolderMtl.
